Put raw images here, then run: python3 build/images.py
All images are made SQUARE except banner (900x500), popup (9:16) and og. Names: see build/images.py.
  banner, popup, hero, about, app, logo, og
  categories/<page key>  (casino, slots, poker, table, jackpot, live, sports, esports, fishing, lottery, instant, app, promotions, welcome-bonus, vip, register, login, tips, affiliate)
  promos/<promo image>   (promo-1 .. promo-4)
  posts/<post key>
